_doc: Campaign calendar for seasonal-copy-leak detection (brand-watch Wave 4,
advisor review 2026-07-07: detect DATES, not words). One entry per
campaign per year. marker_terms are evaluated ONLY when the campaign
window is closed (window_end + graceDays < today) AND the term does not
belong to any currently-open campaign — so in-season copy never flags.
Keep terms high-precision (5-10 per campaign): a term should only ever
appear in that campaign's copy. Latin terms match on word boundaries;
OWNER: whoever plans campaign copy adds next year's entry when the
campaign brief goes out — one JSON row, nothing else to update.
Origin incident: FT_REL_30PCT_8X carried CNY copy for ~5 months on 8 BOs
(found manually 2026-07-07 — this file exists so that never recurs).
_code_exclusion_tokens_doc: Added 2026-07-08 per Wai Yip: promo CODE or NAME containing any of these tokens (case-insensitive substring match) is treated as deliberately seasonal and SKIPPED by brand-watch ENTIRELY — no config check, no MT check, no popup check, no currency check, nothing. This is broader than marker_terms below: marker_terms only gate the seasonal-copy-leak content check on promos that are NOT code-excluded (e.g. a promo with no seasonal token in its code but 'Year of the Horse' baked into its MT copy still gets caught by that check). OWNER: same as campaigns[] below — add a token here when a new campaign's naming convention needs the same treatment.
_game_title_exclusions_doc: Slot GAME titles containing marker terms — stripped from text before scanning, because an FS promo on a seasonal-themed game is legitimately live year-round. Campaign phrasing around the game name (e.g. 'Grand Christmas Streak Challenge') still flags.
